18.0 Introduction¶

Components are grouped by type.

18.1 Samplers¶

HTTP Request¶

This sampler lets you send an HTTP/HTTPS request to a web server. See HTTP Request Defaults.

The default parser is LagartoBasedHtmlParser.

Parameters¶

Attribute
Description
Required
Server Name or IP
Domain name or IP address of the web server.
Yes
^

JSON Extractor¶

The JSON PostProcessor enables you extract data from JSON responses using JSON-PATH syntax. It is easier than __jexl3().
